name: disprove-guard-two-up
description: One claim says purge has no authorization check, but its only caller chain passes through require_admin two frames up; the other is a real shared mutable default

findings.body: `purge` deletes an account and its sessions with no authorization check, so any caller can delete any account.
`record` uses a mutable default `sink=[]`, so every call that omits `sink` appends to one list shared across callers.
